moves.label: Jet Pistol
moves.description: Fast high 2nd Gear jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Quick stretched punch reads as a Jet Pistol.

moves.label: Low Jet Stamp
moves.description: Fast low rubber kick with very long active coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low-to-vertical stretch kick stays in the low attack family.

moves.label: Jet Body Blow
moves.description: Quick mid body blow with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Short 2nd Gear body strike.

moves.label: Jet Gatling
moves.description: Slow mid rush with a long active flurry of stretched punches.
moves.reason: Repeated smoke-trail punches match a Jet Gatling.

moves.label: Jet Launcher
moves.description: Quick mid launcher with extended active pressure and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Rushing 2nd Gear strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Low Jet Feint
moves.description: Fast low feint with very long active rubber-leg coverage.
moves.reason: Long low stretch sequence stays grounded.

moves.label: Low Balloon Drive
moves.description: Slow low knockdown drive with extended balloon-body pressure.
moves.reason: Inflated low body drive is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Jet Giant Rifle
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown punch with extended giant-fist reach and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Huge 2nd Gear fist rush is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Crouching Jet Rush
moves.description: Fast mid crouching rush with extended active steam-trail pressure.
moves.reason: Full-crouch sequence rushes forward with 2nd Gear speed lines.

moves.label: Crouch Jet Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-Jet strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Jet Pistol
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the quick Jet Pistol.

moves.label: Jet Aura Drive
moves.description: Fast special knockdown drive with very long active 2nd Gear pressure.
moves.reason: Long aura drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Jet Punch
moves.description: Fast mid while-rising punch with extended active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses the mid Jet punch.

moves.label: Jet Rising Stamp
moves.description: Fast mid rising stamp with long active rubber-leg coverage and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Rising kick stretches through multiple active frames.

moves.label: Ducking Jet Pistol
moves.description: Fast high ducking Pistol with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the quick Jet Pistol.

moves.label: Diagonal Jet Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal Jet strike is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Jet Bazooka Rush
moves.description: Fast mid advancing rush with very long active twin-fist pressure.
moves.reason: Forward command drives in with enlarged twin fists and smoke trails.

moves.label: Forward Jet Punch
moves.description: Fast mid forward punch with extended active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the mid Jet punch sequence.

moves.label: Jet Rush Pistol
moves.description: Fast high rush Pistol with a moderate active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab uses the Jet Pistol.

moves.label: Jet Burst Stamp
moves.description: Fast mid knockdown burst with very long active rubber-body pressure.
moves.reason: Burst sequence stretches across the screen and is authored as a knockdown.
